title: Repeating Patterns
seo_title: Grade 1 Repeating Patterns Worksheets with Answers (MATATAG Math 1)
standard_text: Determine the next term/s in a repeating pattern (patterns could use rhythmic properties, visual elements in the arts, and other objects); create repeating patterns using objects, images, or numbers.
meta_desc: Free Grade 1 repeating pattern worksheets for the DepEd MATATAG curriculum: what comes next, the part that repeats, missing terms and number patterns. 100 questions with pictures and answers.
key_sub: Keep the same order every time.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • A repeating pattern has a part that repeats again and again: red, blue, red, blue …
  • Find the part that repeats. Then say it again to find what comes next.
  • Patterns can use shapes, colors, sounds, movements or numbers: clap, stamp, clap, stamp.

Examples

Example

▲ ● ● ▲ ● ● ▲ …

the part ▲ ● ● repeats

Answer: next: ●

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Repeating part too shortCheck the part repeats all the way.
Wrong placeContinue from the last term.
Changing the orderKeep the same order every time.
